module.purpose: Implements Redux Toolkit's listener middleware: a Redux middleware that lets code subscribe to actions and run side effects with utilities like take, delay, pause, fork, and cancel, plus error handling and listener management.
module.summary: This module is the core implementation of a Redux listener middleware. It exports factory functions to create the middleware and action creators to add, remove, and clear listeners. Internally it maintains maps of listener entries and executing listeners, supports abort signals for cancellation, provides forked task execution with auto-join, and safely reports errors. The middleware intercepts dispatched actions, checks predicates, and invokes listener effects with an enriched API (take, condition, delay, pause, fork, signal, extra). It ensures original state is captured synchronously before the reducer runs and that listeners can be canceled or cleared even while executing.
module.businessContext: Part of Redux Toolkit state management. Enables reactive side-effects to actions. If it fails, app side-effects and listener-based logic break.
